issue.body:
UJSONResponse uses `ujson.dumps(content, ensure_ascii=False)`, but default for ujson is to also escape forward slashes. The result is that UJSONResponse and JSONResponse produce different results:
```
>>> import json
>>> import ujson
>>> s = "https://google.com/"
>>> print(json.dumps(s))
"https://google.com/"
>>> print(ujson.dumps(s))
"https:\/\/google.com\/"
```

`escape_forward_slashes=False` can be added to UJSONResponse to fix that:
```
class UJSONResponse(JSONResponse):
    media_type = "application/json"

    def render(self, content: typing.Any) -> bytes:
        assert ujson is not None, "ujson must be installed to use UJSONResponse"
        return ujson.dumps(content, ensure_ascii=False, escape_forward_slashes=False).encode("utf-8")
```
issue.title: UJSONResponse and JSONResponse produce different results
